description: One measurement of one non-excluded patch by one legacy pass: 2011 minus 3DEP. The raw material of the correction.

columns.name: dz_m
columns.description: Median of 2011 point heights minus the 3DEP surface (2011 datum-converted, uncorrected)

columns.name: scan_deg
columns.description: Mean scan angle of the 2011 points used

columns.name: t_s
columns.description: Mean GPS time of the 2011 points used (pass time domain)

columns.name: x_m
columns.description: Mean position of the 2011 points used

columns.name: gx
columns.description: 3DEP surface gradient dz/dx at the patch (horizontal-shift term)
